title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Us
Turnkey is developer-first infrastructure for private key management, making it simple to create wallets, sign transactions, and automate on-chain actions through one elegant API, without ever exposing sensitive key material. Founded by the team who scaled Coinbase Custody from zero to a $100M+ ARR business and helped protect over $100B in crypto assets, Turnkey is tackling crypto security at its foundational level. Our mission is to make strong cryptography the default across the open internet the same way AWS made scalable computing the default for software.
Our team is low-ego, high-agency, and high-autonomy, with a significant amount of combined experience in cryptography, security, and low-level systems. We're building the trustless, programmable infrastructure that will power the next wave of mass-market crypto applications and we're looking for people who want to shape what that future looks like.
We are seeking an Engineering Manager to drive growth throughout our engineering organization. If you’re excited about the potential that web3 has to radically change the world for the better and have a sincere desire to help facilitate that change, join us as we redefine decentralized development.
What You’ll Do:
Strategic Vision and Leadership

• Develop and articulate the overarching engineering strategy and technical vision

• Manage a high-performing engineering team and guide the development of Turnkey ’s product and infrastructure

• Identify and evaluate emerging technologies and trends in web3 and guide their integration into our product and infrastructure

• Collaborate with leadership to drive recruitment and onboarding of top engineering talent

• Contribute to overall strategic planning and technical decision making

Architectural Oversight & Technical Direction

• Provide strategic technical guidance and leadership, ensuring intelligent architectural decisions that support our long-term goals

• Oversee the design and implementation of modern application architectures, optimized for the unique challenges of web3

• Ensure the scalability, security, and reliability of our infrastructure, addressing the complexities of decentralized systems

• Contribute to defining and delivering processes that drive quality & consistency to our product & infrastructure development

What We’re Looking For:

• Previous managerial experience

• An understanding of modern application architectures and ability to lead in-depth discussions on how they should be developed and deployed

• Excellence at holding a high-bar on software and the requisite engineering processes

• A healthy amount of paranoia :-)

Style points

• Prior experience working in fast-paced crypto/web3 and/or FinTech companies

• Actively tracking developments in the crypto ecosystem and opinionated on where it’s going

What We Offer

• Full benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability, HSA/FSA, 401(k) - detailed benefits overview available as we get further in the process

• Paid parental leave

• Unlimited PTO

• $3,000/yr learning and development budget to attend industry conferences

• Multiple team offsites per year

• Lunch stipend

Turnkey is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply.

Compensation range

$200,000-$275,000 USD

• Introductions Made: Actively identify and connect restaurants to Slang’s Account Executives via email introductions.

• Conversions: Facilitate successful deals by introducing restaurants with a high likelihood of adopting Slang.ai .

• Compensation Earned: You will earn monetary rewards based on the number of successful deals closed from your referrals.

• Industry Expertise: A strong network in the restaurant industry, with proven connections to decision-makers.

• Entrepreneurship: A self-starter mindset with the ability to work independently and manage your time effectively.

• Collaborative Spirit: A willingness to engage with Slang’s team and contribute to the program’s overall success.

• Alignment with Our Mission: Passion for innovation and improving the customer experience in the restaurant industry.

Compensation is monetary and based on performance, offering a straightforward and rewarding engagement model.
Our Vision
Calling a business shouldn’t feel like a robot-hostage situation, where you’re forced to listen to horrible music and can't reach a human, while enduring a soulless voice uttering "I'm sorry I didn't quite get that" on repeat for eternity. (shudder) That’s why we started Slang.ai . We use the latest AI and audio wizardry to make transacting via voice so enjoyable it’s more human than human. By 2030, we will save businesses and consumers 1 billion minutes of precious time while transforming voice channels into the preferred mode of communication (it's faster and easier than text).

Actively AI is defining a new category: Intelligence-Led Revenue.

Revenue organizations have always been bottlenecked on human capacity. Reps triage which accounts get attention. Context disappears at every handoff. On any given day, the vast majority of accounts have exactly zero people thinking about them.

Actively addresses this at the structural level. Our platform deploys Per-Account AgentsTM across our customers’ TAM, working 24/7 to research, identify opportunities, and advance next steps without being asked. Leading enterprises including Ramp, Ironclad, and Samsara are already making this shift.

Our co-founders are former Stanford AI researchers, and the team comes from Harvard, CMU, Berkeley, Brex, Scale AI, and Google. We've raised $68M from TCV, First Harmonic, Bain Capital Ventures, First Round Capital, and more.

title: Senior Principal Software Architect, DataEdge Strategy & Architecture
description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
Job Description Summary:
Job Overview:
The Senior Principal Architect defines and drives the technical strategy across the DataEdge portfolio. In close partnership with Product Management, Engineering, Support, and executive leadership, this role aligns product roadmaps, platform investments, and architectural decisions with customer needs, business objectives, and Rocket's strategy to become a platform company.
The DataEdge portfolio includes Rocket's data integration, replication, synchronization, virtualization, and data intelligence solutions. It helps customers unlock enterprise data across distributed, cloud, and mainframe environments by making trusted data available where it is needed. As AI adoption accelerates, DataEdge delivers trusted, connected, and actionable information to the applications, platforms, models, agents, and intelligent business processes that power modern digital enterprises.
This role will evolve the portfolio into an integrated platform through cloud-native architecture, shared services, AI-enabled innovation, and cross-product collaboration. Success requires technical leadership and the ability to build alignment and shared ownership.
Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

• Partner with Product Management to define the DataEdge platform strategy and translate business priorities into a shared, cross-product technical roadmap.

• Build alignment across Product and Engineering teams, balancing product needs with portfolio-wide platform objectives.

• Collaborate with architects across DataEdge, other Rocket portfolios, and business units to identify shared platform opportunities, promote consistency, and drive alignment on strategic architectural decisions.

• Drive reusable services, APIs, frameworks, and common platform capabilities while consolidating overlapping technologies.

• Define cloud-native strategies for deployment, configuration, scalability, observability, security, and operational excellence.

• Lead the adoption and integration of AI platform capabilities, intelligent automation, MCP, and agentic systems across the DataEdge portfolio.

• Partner with Product teams to identify and prioritize AI capabilities that create measurable customer value and competitive differentiation.

• Represent the DataEdge technology vision internally and externally. Maintain awareness of industry trends, analyst perspectives, emerging technologies, and competitive offerings to help shape portfolio strategy and investment priorities.

• Shape how DataEdge fits within the broader data, analytics, and AI ecosystem, collaborating across Rocket portfolios and external technology partners to deliver integrated platform capabilities and differentiated customer outcomes.

• Promote adoption of industry standards, open APIs, and interoperability frameworks to ensure DataEdge integrates effectively across diverse customer environments and technology ecosystems.

• Coach teams on AI-enabled development, including AI-assisted coding, testing, documentation, modernization, and delivery.

• Lead architecture reviews, communicate decisions and tradeoffs, and mentor senior technical talent across the portfolio.

Required Qualifications:

• Minimum 10 years of software engineering experience

• Proven experience defining architecture and technology strategy across multiple enterprise products or platforms.

• Strong expertise in LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, retrieval architectures, enterprise AI integration, and responsible AI patterns.

• Demonstrated delivery of AI-enabled product capabilities and adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices.

title: Strategic Deals Lead, Compute Partnerships
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Strategic Deals Lead, you will shape and execute Anthropic's partnerships with the hyperscalers and cloud service providers that supply the compute we train and serve frontier models on. As Anthropic scales its infrastructure footprint, you will originate, structure, negotiate, and close the deals that put that strategy into effect - securing large-scale compute capacity and, increasingly, shaping how Anthropic's models are distributed, priced, and sold through those same partners' platforms

Securing that infrastructure at scale requires cultivating strong partnerships across the hyperscaler and cloud service provider ecosystem - partnerships that cut across compute, go-to-market, and product teams. These relationships span multi-year compute commitments, financing structures, model availability on the partner's platform, co-selling and marketplace arrangements, and joint go-to-market motions. You will be the person who connects those threads: working with engineering and infrastructure teams to understand what compute Anthropic needs, and with product, go-to-market, finance, and legal teams to make sure the commercial and distribution terms we agree to reinforce rather than constrain each other.

We are looking for people who combine a deep understanding of cloud and AI infrastructure with strong strategic judgment, financial acumen, and the negotiating skill to close complex agreements at the terms and timelines Anthropic requires. You will be an integral part of a team focused on ensuring Anthropic has the resources it needs to pursue its mission of developing safe, beneficial AI systems.

Key responsibilities

• Own the strategy and deal pipeline that expands Anthropic's access to compute and infrastructure, and connects the product and go-to-market components of those partnerships.

• Lead the full deal lifecycle for large-scale cloud and compute transactions, from opportunity identification and term sheet development through negotiation, execution, and close

Build and own executive-level relationships with commercial, finance, product, and legal counterparts at hyperscalers and cloud providers

• Support product and go-to-market leadership in structuring and negotiating the product and go-to-market elements of hyperscaler partnerships - including model availability on partner platforms, marketplace and co-sell arrangements, pricing and revenue-share constructs, and joint customer motions

• Bring capital markets and finance expertise to transactions, developing frameworks for evaluating deal economics, counterparty risk, and the financing components of compute infrastructure

• Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to understand future workload requirements and translate them into long-term compute and ecosystem strategies and commercially viable deal terms

• Partner with Legal, Finance, Product, and Engineering to align deal terms with Anthropic's technical, financial, commercial, and risk requirements

• Monitor market, technology, competitive, and financing developments across the AI infrastructure landscape and provide clear recommendations and deal reporting to senior leadership

Minimum qualifications

• Experience in cloud computing, AI infrastructure, or adjacent technology ecosystems, with a strong understanding of hyperscaler platforms, compute and accelerator technologies, and cloud and infrastructure economics

• Demonstrated track record of structuring, negotiating, and closing complex, high-value technology transactions or strategic partnerships as the lead negotiator. This role requires someone who can operate independently from day one

title: Football Systems Operator - Nederland
description:

WAAR DRAAIT HET WERK OM?

Als Football Systems Operator zul je in Eredivisie voetbal stadions in Nederland en in het VAR Replay Center in Zeist werken. Je bent een essentieel onderdeel in de wekelijkse levering van onze diensten voor de KNVB. Met meer ervaring, zul je ook de mogelijkheid krijgen om voor andere competities te werken, zoals UEFA Champions League, UEFA Europa League en wedstrijden van het Nederlands elftal.

Hawk-Eye Innovations is onderdeel van Sony Sports en is bekend geworden door technologische ondersteuning van scheidsrechters in tennis en voetbal (Goal-Line-Technology (GLT) https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I3JzO2hG4rw)

De hoofdtaak van Hawk-Eye Nederland is het leveren van VAR https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AIpTwndDp1U (Video Assistant Referee) in de Eredivisie. Door het jaar heen zul je voor alle aspecten van het werk verantwoordelijk zijn, van het opzetten van het systeem bij het stadion, tot het operaten van het systeem in het Replay Center https://www.knvb.nl/nieuws/themas/arbitrage-20/49356/zo-ziet-het-arag-knvb-replay-center-eruitin samenwerking met de Nederlandse scheidsrechters. Gedurende het jaar zul je voldoende mogelijkheden krijgen om andere services (zoals Player-tracking en GLT) te ervaren. Met de tijd zul je meer verantwoordelijkheden krijgen en kun je doorgroeien naar een rol die bij jou past.

Bij Hawk-Eye maak je voetbal van dichtbij mee, samen met je collega`s word je echt onderdeel van de wedstrijd. Je komt op veel verschillende plekken, van de kleine stadions tot de grootste voetbaltempels. Het is een avontuurlijke baan waarbij je veel zult meemaken! 

HOE ZIET EEN TYPISCHE DAG ERUIT?

- Opzetten van Hawk-Eye technologie in het stadion waaronder de monitor naast het veld, audio apparatuur en het verbinden van netwerk en video bekabeling.

- Het doortesten van het systeem voorafgaand aan de wedstrijd in samenwerking met je collega’s.

- Contactpersoon voor het stadion, scheidsrechters en TV productie op locatie

- Werken met (video-)scheidsrechters om hen zo snel mogelijk van de juiste herhaling en beste camerahoek te voorzien, zodat de juiste beslissing kan worden gemaakt. 

- Monitoren van het systeem gedurende de wedstrijd en eventuele problemen oplossen.

- Het onderhouden van hardware en software op doordeweekse dagen.

WAT VERWACHTEN WE VAN JOU

- Een goede technische aanleg, met interesse in voetbal en video technologie.

- Zelfstandigheid en probleemoplossend vermogen.

- Het vermogen om onder tijdsdruk en in stressvolle situaties te kunnen werken.

- Bereidheid om in het binnenland te reizen en in het buitenland te werken.

- Bereidheid om VAR bussen naar stadions te rijden

- Flexibel inzetbaar en bereid om in het weekend en avond te werken.

- Een opleidingsniveau van MBO-niveau 4 of hoger.

Bij Hawk-Eye Innovations waarderen we het belang van jouw persoonlijke groei en potentieel. We zullen je trainen en begeleiden om zo snel mogelijk een zelfstandige rol te krijgen in ons team. Als we zien dat je in een specifiek gebied jezelf ontwikkelt of ergens nog in kan verbeteren, zullen we er beide aan werken om er sterker uit te kunnen komen.

We kijken ernaar uit om je sollicitatie te ontvangen en te ontdekken hoe jij kunt bijdragen aan de toekomst van Technologie in de sportwereld bij Sony Sports.

title: Product Manager (Interviews & Interview Assessment)
description:
Product Manager (Interviews & Interview Assessment)

CAS Shield & Apply

📍 Location: Remote (with purpose-driven in-person meetups in London)

📝 Contract: Full-time, permanent

📅 Start Date: Immediate

💼 Reporting to: Deputy Director of CAS Shield, with a dotted line to the Deputy Director of Apply

🛂 Note: Candidates must be UK-based, have the right to work in the UK, and be able to travel to London for team meet-ups

About Enroly

At Enroly, we’re transforming the way universities recruit, assess and onboard international students. Our platforms are used by a significant share of UK higher education institutions to streamline compliance, reduce administrative burden, and improve the international student experience.

This role sits across our two core products:

• CAS Shield - our flagship compliance and pre-CAS platform, trusted by nearly half of UK higher education institutions to manage visa readiness, credibility and onboarding at scale.

• Apply - our application and admissions product, where institutions, agents and applicants come together at the very start of the student journey.

Enroly was recently acquired by Ecctis, the UK’s leading authority on international qualifications and skills benchmarking. Ecctis delivers essential services including qualification evaluation, recognition frameworks, and global consulting to governments, education providers, and employers. Together, we’re building a future-proofed approach to student recruitment and enrolment, backed by unparalleled data, insight, and capability.

The Role

We’re looking for a Product Manager to own Interviews and Interview Assessment across CAS Shield and Apply.

This is not a backlog-management role. You will be expected to define the product direction, make strategic trade-offs and establish how interviewing and assessment should work across Enroly's products.

Interviewing is one of the highest-stakes moments in the international student journey. Institutions use it to establish credibility, assess English language ability, and make admissions and compliance decisions that carry real regulatory weight. Applicants experience it on a mobile phone, often on a poor connection, in a different time zone, and frequently as their first direct interaction with the university.

Your job is to make that experience work - fair, credible, defensible and genuinely usable at scale. You’ll own the roadmap for asynchronous and live interviewing, assessment and scoring, and the integrity and proctoring capabilities that sit around them. This is a build-and-scale role: parts of this space are new, and you’ll be shaping direction as much as delivering against it.

This role suits someone who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment, can balance applicant experience against institutional and regulatory needs, and is excited to define a product area rather than inherit one.

What You’ll Do

• Own and drive the product roadmap for Interviews and Interview Assessment across both CAS Shield and Apply, aligned with Enroly’s company strategy.

• Define the interviewing model: asynchronous and live formats, question design and banks, scoring rubrics, reviewer workflows, and assessment outputs institutions can act on and defend.

• Own integrity and proctoring: identity verification, fraud and impersonation signals, AI-assisted detection, and the balance between assurance and a humane applicant experience.

• Lead the mobile-first applicant experience - video capture, low-bandwidth resilience, accessibility, and drop-off reduction across devices and geographies.

• Make the case for AI where it genuinely helps - transcription, summarisation, scoring support, anomaly detection - while keeping humans accountable for decisions.

• Ensure interviews and assessment work coherently across two products, with a consistent experience for applicants and clear ownership boundaries internally.

• Work directly with university admissions and compliance teams, agents, applicants

The focus is singular: talent density and the culture that sustains it. You make sure the few people we hire are exceptional, that our strong people stay and grow, and that our values remain a working standard rather than a poster.

title: Director of Demand Generation
description:
Meeting Tomorrow is a 23-year-old company with a growing team of 90 talented, friendly people. We’re headquartered in Chicago, with about 80% of our team working remotely in cities across the country.
We are a full-service event agency with three core divisions: planning, production, and creative. We plan and produce corporate events of every shape and size, partnering with clients that include Fortune 500 companies and leading organizations across a wide array of industries.
We’re known for our exceptional customer experience, our collaborative culture, and our can-do spirit. Our culture has earned us recognition as a Top 20 Inspiring Workplace in North America, as well as the Events Industry Council's Social Impact Award. We offer great benefits, the best coworkers you’ll find anywhere, and the opportunity to work in a dynamic, team-oriented environment. We can’t wait to meet you!

The Opportunity
We’re looking for a Director of Demand Generation to own a qualified pipeline from first touch to sales handoff. You’ll drive leads across three channels: paid advertising (Google, LinkedIn), organic search and SEO, and AI-powered search and LLM visibility (GEO). You’ll report to the VP of Marketing, and partner closely with our Sales team.
This is a builder role. You’ll own the strategy, run the channels, and build the agentic workflows that make the whole machine run more efficiently over time. Your success is measured in the qualified pipeline, not activity.
What You’ll Own
Pipeline end to end: qualified leads across inbound and outbound channels, from first touch to sales handoff
Paid advertising: Google Ads and LinkedIn, with full budget accountability and a bias toward what actually converts
Organic search and SEO: making Meeting Tomorrow’s content and website attractive to Google and ranking for the terms that matter to our buyers
LLM and GEO: growing Meeting Tomorrow’s presence in AI-powered search and recommendation environments
Agentic workflows: building and managing the automations that drive campaign efficiency and compress time-to-pipeline
Demand gen KPIs: CPL, MQL volume and quality, MQL-to-SQL conversion, pipeline contribution, and CAC, with regular visibility to leadership
Budget decisions: full accountability for how demand gen dollars are allocated, with the VP of Marketing in the loop
Key Responsibilities
Build and execute the demand generation roadmap, aligned to revenue targets and Sales priorities
Own SEO strategy and execution: keyword targeting, on-page optimization, content signals, and technical SEO in partnership with the web team
Manage paid media across Google and LinkedIn: campaign structure, targeting, creative testing, and budget allocation
Develop Meeting Tomorrow’s presence in AI-powered search (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) through GEO strategies
Build and iterate on agentic workflows that automate repeatable marketing functions, from lead scoring to outreach sequencing
Run A/B tests and side-by-side comparisons across channels to continuously improve performance
Partner with Sales on lead handoff, pipeline review cadences, and feedback loops
Ensure all outbound programs comply with CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and CCPA
Who You Are
You’re a builder. You see a gap, you close it. You don’t wait for someone to tell you how.
You’re entrepreneurial about channels: when something works, you double down. When it doesn’t, you move on and find what does.
You think in systems and automation. The goal is a demand gen function that compounds over time, not one that depends on you doing everything manually.
You treat Sales like a partner, not an internal customer. Pipeline is a team sport.
You can walk into ambiguity, build structure, and make progress without waiting for someone to hand you a playbook.
 
What You’ve Done
Proven SEO expertise: you know how to make a website and its content rank. You’ve done it, you can show the results, and you understand the technical and content sides of the discipline.

Conveo is a Y Combinator-backed company in an active growth period. We started this year as a team of ~20 and are on track to reach ~120 people by year end. The people who join now have an outsized chance to shape how this company is built.

Watch Boris give a walkthrough here 👆

WHAT WE'RE BUILDING AND WHY

Conveo is the AI-powered infrastructure for continuous consumer understanding. Traditional research lands weeks late, as one-off reports that never build on each other. Conveo replaces that with an always-on layer, AI-moderated interviews at scale, feeding a knowledge base that compounds with every study. Global brands like Unilever, Google, and P&G already use it to catch shifts before competitors do. Our ambition: become the go-to platform for all consumer insights - the infrastructure companies run on, not a service they call in occasionally.

The internal apps engineering team builds products that give the humans at Conveo maximum leverage. As the cost of building software falls to zero, we craft opinionated internal tools that fit exactly how we work, from full apps (CRM, account management, recruitment), agents that run across the business, and the tooling that lets anyone at Conveo automate their own workflows.

This team sits inside Engineering and is the group actually building these apps day to day. There are two of us on it today - you'd be the third.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

We need a doer who works backwards from the experience. This is someone who starts with the user's problem, not a spec, and owns everything between that conversation and the code that ships. You shape what gets built and how, contributing to product direction with real technical and strategic impact.

Own the full stack, from the interface to the infrastructure

Build the internal tools the team uses every day and can't imagine working without. From API and MCP design to infrastructure on Vercel, AWS, Supabase, and BigQuery, plus the agents that work across the stack, you own complete features end to end, including the AI-powered ones built on LLM APIs, prompt engineering, and async pipelines.

Be the engineering voice in every team you serve

You hold weekly one-on-ones with the people who actually use your tools, form a clear point of view on what to build, translate their feedback into scoped decisions, and follow through.

AI-First

You reach for agentic solutions first, using AI to reason, build, review, and test at every stage. Building our own internal stack instead of buying third-party tools means recreating, for our own purposes, software others spent twenty years building, so staying on the bleeding edge of AI is how we close that gap fast. And because these are internal apps, we can lean on AI far more aggressively than an external product could: we're close to our users, feedback is immediate, and the upside of a new feature usually outweighs the cost of a bug we can fix fast. The bias is toward speed and learning. We're looking for people who thrive on that edge and help us continuously improve our software factory.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

- 5+ years of experience building applications or tooling that automate human workflows

- Full-stack experience across the board: API design, data

title: Staff Product Manager, Growth Alliance (all genders)
description:
The role

HelloFresh's Onboarding squad owns the highest-leverage window in the customer lifecycle: from the moment a prospect converts to the moment they become a settled, loyal customer. Onboarding is the connective tissue that links the conversion funnel to long-term customer value.

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager to lead the Onboarding squad and define the product vision for how HelloFresh guides new customers from their first delivery into habitual, high-value subscription. You will own the end-to-end early customer experience across web and app - spanning post-checkout confirmation, subscription management, digital engagement, and the critical Box 1→2→3 progression - across all HelloFresh Group brands, including Factor.

The defining product challenge ahead is building and scaling the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: an ML-powered, segment-aware system that identifies the right action for each customer at each moment in their early lifecycle and delivers it seamlessly across web and app surfaces. This is a genuine 0-to-1 build - one that requires both strategic vision and hands-on execution.

This role demands a PM who is obsessed with solving customer pain points and equally obsessed with the cross-squad collaboration required to do it at scale. Onboarding does not sit inside a single product surface - it spans the activation funnel, CRM and lifecycle communications, app and engagement experiences, and Data Science. The PM leading this squad must be a hyper-collaborator: capable of aligning diverse stakeholders across squads and tribes and bringing coherence to an experience that crosses many surfaces and teams.

What you'll do

• Own the product vision and strategy for the end-to-end Onboarding experience across all HelloFresh Group brands - from post-checkout confirmation to Settled Conversion (3 boxes in 4 weeks).

• Lead the build and scaling of the Next Best Action (NBA) framework: a segment-aware, state-aware personalisation system that dynamically surfaces the right customer action at the right moment across web and app.

• Drive measurable improvement in Settled Conversion rate through a high-velocity experimentation roadmap.

• Own the full-surface onboarding experience - welcome dashboard, subscription management, meal selection flows, app onboarding layer, and CRM-triggered touchpoints - ensuring coherence and quality across every channel and surface.

• Partner with Data Science and Engineering to define the data and ML foundations that power personalised, segment-aware onboarding at scale.

• Act as the connective tissue between squads and tribes: align the Activation funnel squad, CRM and Communications tribe, and App and Engagement team around a unified onboarding strategy and shared north-star metrics.

• Build deep consumer empathy through qualitative research, quantitative funnel analysis, and direct customer engagement - and bring the early customer voice into every product decision.

• Define and own success metrics for Onboarding - Settled Conversion rate, Box 1→2 and 2→3 conversion, app adoption rate, and unwanted box rate - and hold yourself and the squad accountable to them.

• Own BAU operations: triage funnel issues rapidly, maintain onboarding health monitoring, and serve as the escalation point for anything threatening early retention performance.

• Drive cross-functional alignment as a single-threaded leader across global tribes and alliances - creating clarity and shared direction needed for the squad to ship at velocity.

What you'll bring

• Customer Lifecycle & Early Retention Expertise: A deep understanding of subscription customer lifecycle dynamics - churn triggers, early retention levers, and the interplay between product experience and commercial outcomes. You think in journeys, not screens, and you can translate moments of friction or delight into business impact across the Box 0→3 window.

• Cross-Surface Product Leadership: Proven experience owning end-to-end product

The foundation is seeking a Protocol Engineer to join their technical team and contribute to the development of smart contracts for in-house projects, the protocol, Unichain, and grantee collaborations.
As a Protocol Engineer, the candidate will play a key role in designing, implementing, and optimizing smart contract systems. The role involves participating in technical design discussions, weighing trade-offs between optimization, flexibility, and integration, while also providing design feedback for ecosystem participants such as hook developers and Unichain DeFi projects.
What the Candidate Will Do:

• Design, implement, and optimize Solidity-based smart contracts for projects related to the protocol, focusing on security, efficiency, and maintainability.

• Provide technical guidance and design feedback for external developers building on the protocol and Unichain, including hook developers and DeFi projects.

• Explore and prototype new DeFi primitives, trading mechanisms, and smart contract architectures to expand the protocol’s capabilities.

• Participate in design sessions and code reviews, ensuring high standards in code quality, security, and organization.

• Implement unit tests, fuzz testing, and gas optimizations to ensure smart contract reliability and performance.

As a Protocol Engineer, the candidate may work on:

• Hooks and reference implementations for the protocol's latest version

- Experimental swapping UX designs

• Indexers and graph traversal algorithms

- Composable DeFi legos
- SDK abstractions and developer tooling

• Periphery integrations such as liquidity management tools and swap-and-add functionalities

What the Candidate Brings to the Table:
Required Skills & Experience:

• Strong understanding of DeFi patterns and smart contract architecture

• At least two years of experience writing complex Solidity smart contracts with an emphasis on readability, maintainability, and security

• Proficiency with Foundry, including cheatcodes, foundry.toml, and script execution

• Experience with unit testing and fuzz testing for smart contract security

• Confidence using Git and managing version control in a collaborative engineering environment

• Ability to design clean abstractions and reusable smart contract components

• Familiarity with the protocol's latest version contracts and related DeFi protocols

Nice to Haves:

• Experience with Yul and low-level opcodes for gas-efficient smart contract development

• Knowledge of gas optimization techniques

• Experience with invariant testing for smart contract correctness

• Public speaking experience for developer outreach and technical presentations

• Familiarity with TypeScript for SDK and front-end integrations

About the Foundation:
In pursuit of a more open and fair financial system, the foundation supports the growth, decentralization, and sustainability of the community. Through grants, they are driving value in five key focus areas: Protocol and Innovation, Developers, Governance, Research, and Security. Their grant-making approach is designed to maximize positive impact, bringing in new contributors to the community who focus on building new initiatives, committees, products, infrastructure, and more. As the Priority Initiative Leader for Uniting Americans Around Our Founding Principles (UAFP), you will serve as the key strategic leader accountable for developing and refining the strategy and theory of change for how Stand Together and its network of partners build a shared American identity grounded in the country’s founding principles, replacing a narrative of division with one of shared purpose and bottom-up contribution.
This role sits at the intersection of narrative and movement strategy, high-profile coalition leadership, and civics-market building. You will bring together a distinctive set of stakeholders spanning professional sports leagues and franchises, musicians and entertainment partners, philanthropic partners across the ideological spectrum, civics education organizations, and community leaders, around a shared campaign to make founding-principles-based citizenship culturally resonant at national scale. You will integrate the full breadth of Stand Together’s capabilities, from national brand campaigns and content production to fundraising and partner development, to ensure the movement’s narrative, action, and civics pillars compound rather than run independently.
We are looking for someone who operates as the chief executive of a portfolio: reading a fast-moving cultural landscape quickly, prioritizing which opportunities will drive the highest level of impact, making the trade-offs that follow, and building the leaders who will implement the strategies.
The ideal candidate brings experience shaping national-scale brand, cultural, or narrative campaigns, and has a track record of building coalitions with high-profile partners spanning business, entertainment, sports, and philanthropy. Done well, this role will make founding-principles-based citizenship a living part of American culture rather than a civics-class abstraction.

Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.   
 
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success.  That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

title: Senior SecOps Specialist
description:
Hello. We’re Teya.

Teya was founded on a simple belief: local businesses deserve better.

They are the cafés, restaurants, salons, shops and entrepreneurs that bring character to our high streets, create jobs and keep communities moving. Yet for too long, financial services has made life harder for them - with clunky tools, poor support and complexity that gets in the way of running a business.

Teya exists to change that.

We’re building a financial platform for local businesses across Europe - one built around simple tools, thoughtful design and real human support. Our Members rely on us to help them run their business with confidence, and that responsibility shapes the way we work.

We move fast. We care about quality. We stay close to the detail. And we believe great performance and genuine hospitality should go hand in hand.

If you want to build meaningful products, solve real problems and make a genuine difference for local businesses, we’d love to hear from you

YOUR MISSION

As a SecOps Specialist, you protect Teya by detecting, investigating, and responding to security incidents while ensuring our security operations are reliable, scalable, and continuously improving.

You will lead complex SOC investigations, provide L3 support, maintain and improve core security tooling, and build automations and integrations that increase speed, consistency, and quality across security operations.

You will work closely with Security Engineering, IT, Infrastructure, Platform, Cloud, and Product teams to reduce risk and embed security effectively across the organisation.

You operate across incident response, detection engineering, security tooling, vulnerability management, threat intelligence, telemetry, and automation - turning operational insight into stronger controls and better engineering outcomes.

Responsibilities

Security Operations & Incident Response

• Lead end-to-end investigation and response of complex security incidents.

• Act as L3 escalation point for SOC analysts and MSSP.

• Coordinate across Security, Engineering, IT, Cloud, Legal, and Compliance during

incidents.

• Make clear, risk-based decisions under pressure with strong documentation.

• Maintain playbooks, runbooks, and incident workflows.

• Drive post-incident reviews and ensure improvements are implemented and follow-ups

completed.

• Support incident metrics (MTTD, MTTR, recurrence, etc.)

SOC Tooling & Platform Operations

• Operate and improve SIEM, EDR, email security, case management, and vulnerability

tools.

• Monitor health, coverage, data quality, and integrations.

• Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, API, and configuration issues.

• Build and maintain integrations between security tools and internal systems.

• Manage upgrades, changes, access reviews, and documentation.

• Apply engineering practices (version control, testing, peer review, rollback).

• Reduce operational toil through automation and simplification.

Vulnerability Management

• Analyse and prioritise vulnerabilities based on risk and exploitability.

• Work with Engineering and IT to drive remediation.

• Track fixes, validate resolution, and escalate high-risk issues.

• Improve vulnerability workflows and automation.

• Identify recurring issues and recommend preventative controls.

Detection Engineering

• Build, test, and maintain detection rules, queries, and correlation logic.

• Manage full detection lifecycle (build → test → tune → measure → retire).

• Use version control and detection-as-code where possible.

• Reduce false positives and improve detection quality and coverage.

• Map detections to threat behaviours (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK).

• Validate detections through testing, incidents, and simulations.

Log & Telemetry Management

• Onboard and maintain log sources across cloud, identity, endpoint, network, and SaaS.

• Ensure logs are complete, reliable, and usable for detection and investigation.

• Troubleshoot ingestion, parsing, schema, and data quality

title: SW Developer categorie protette L.68/99 (anche art. 18) - Full Remote
description:
Develer è un’azienda del gruppo Comelz, che svolge attività di progettazione, produzione elettronica e sviluppo software per il mondo industriale.
Cerchiamo nuovi collaboratori e collaboratrici da inserire nei nostri team di sviluppo software, appartenenti alle categorie protette, in tre aree:

• Embedded Linux e firmware

• Sviluppo desktop e embedded

• Sviluppo web full stack

Su cosa lavoriamo?
I progetti tipici su cui lavoriamo riguardano:
Embedded Linux e firmware

• Applicazioni ferroviarie, anche in sicurezza

• Controllo di processi di automazione industriale.

• Macchine a controllo numerico, per controllo motori e bus di campo industriali.

• Internet of Things (con trasmissioni dati in Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, GSM).

• Interfacce utente per dispositivi embedded con display touch.

Sviluppo desktop e embedded

• Controllo di macchine industriali.

• Realizzazione di interfacce utente per dispositivi embedded con display touch.

• Software per il disegno tecnico 2D e 3D per il settore calzaturiero.

Sviluppo web full stack

• Analisi e reportistica di dati acquisiti da macchine industriali.

• Raccolta e visualizzazione di metriche collezionate da applicazioni web.

• Portali per la configurazione e gestione remota di macchine industriali.

A seconda del tipo di progetto, la parte principale del lavoro consisterà in:
Embedded Linux e firmware

• Sviluppare a basso livello su un sistema Linux embedded: realizzazione di BSP, kernel driver, demoni user space.

• Sviluppare in C su bare metal / microcontrollori: driver e uso di RTOS.

• Aiutare il team di progettisti elettronici nel test e debug delle schede progettate.

Sviluppo desktop e embedded

• Realizzare applicazioni multipiattaforma (desktop e tablet), utilizzando le librerie Qt

• Creare interfacce utente, su sistemi desktop o embedded, e costruire il collegamento verso la logica di backend

• Scrivere algoritmi e logiche di backend al servizio delle applicazioni

Sviluppo web full stack

• Realizzare interfacce di controllo per dispositivi industriali accessibili da browser.

• Sviluppare API HTTP per l'interoperabilità di applicazioni web e mobile.

• Creare applicazioni web per per il monitoraggio di dispositivi e la reportistica di dati in tempo reale.

• Contribuire allo sviluppo di applicazioni web distribuite, realizzate con microservizi, che fanno uso di Amazon AWS.

Per Embedded Linux e firmware , ti capiterà di dover accedere agli schemi elettrici delle schede, realizzati con Altium Designer. A volte, sarà necessario creare degli strumenti software per semplificare lo sviluppo o per realizzare piccoli applicativi di test: in questi casi, i linguaggi e le tecnologie che preferiamo usare sono C++, Python, Bash, Go, Qt / QML.
Per lo sviluppo software desktop ed embedded è un requisito la conoscenza di almeno uno tra i linguaggi C , C++ , Python e Go .
Per lo sviluppo software web full stack ti chiediamo la conoscenza delle principali tecnologie legate allo sviluppo software moderno per il web: in particolare, per la parte di frontend, angular.js o react.js . Per la parte di backend, lavoriamo con Python o Go , ma, se utilizzi altri linguaggi, non ti preoccupare, per noi non costituisce un problema.
Siamo alla ricerca di persone appassionate, curiose, intraprendenti e flessibili che vogliano contribuire alla crescita dei progetti attraverso la realizzazione di sistemi tecnologicamente avanzati e dalle elevate prestazioni e affidabilità.
Cerchiamo persone capaci di identificare le soluzioni e gli strumenti più adatti, con l’obiettivo di aumentare il valore e la qualità dei prodotti che offriamo.
Si richiede l'appartenenza alle Categorie Protette L. 68/99 (anche art. 18)
Come lavoriamo?

• I progetti sono affidati a team piccoli (2-5 persone in media), con un project manager, che svolge anche il ruolo di account manager verso il cliente, e un tech leader per la direzione tecnica e l’organizzazione del lavoro: solitamente ogni team segue un progetto alla volta.

title: Senior Security Engineer
description:
A Inloco é uma empresa de inteligência que usa dados de localização para tornar aplicativos mais relevantes e seguros para seus usuários.

Temos sede em Recife e São Paulo, e nossa empresa-irmã, Incognia , tem escritórios em Palo Alto e Nova Iorque. Atualmente nossa tecnologia está embarcada em mais de 60M+ de dispositivos.

Utilizamos dados comportamentais de localização para aumentar a segurança da conta de usuários, reduzir fraudes e fornecer serviços de localização privada sensíveis ao contexto. Nossa tecnologia utiliza sinais de rede e sensores no dispositivo para fornecer informações de localização altamente precisas. Ao construir um padrão de comportamento anônimo, único para cada usuário, fornecemos contexto de localização e criamos uma identidade digital privada para a segurança das contas. Empresas com aplicativos e dispositivos conectados usam nossa tecnologia para verificação de identidade de usuários sem fricção, autenticação dinâmica adaptativa, avaliação de risco e detecção de fraude, tudo isso enquanto protegem a privacidade do usuário.

Quais são as atividades?

• Arquitetar, projetar e desenvolver soluções e ferramentas avançadas para melhorar a segurança da empresa e ajudar as equipes a manter a segurança

• Coordenar projetos de segurança entre as equipes da Inloco

• Facilitar a colaboração com outros engenheiros, gerentes de produto e líderes para incorporar o pensamento de segurança nos departamentos

• Ser uma referência técnica dentro da equipe com a qual trabalha e dentro da Inloco em geral

• Corrigir incidentes relacionados à segurança e participar da rotação de plantão

• Participar como um membro ativo do trabalho de pentests de aplicativos da web, infraestrutura e aplicativos móveis

• Quais são os requisitos?

• Sólida base em princípios, conceitos, terminologias e estratégias de segurança da informação

• Experiência em criação de um programa de segurança da informação, com foco em uma das principais áreas de segurança da informação. Idealmente, você criou um programa de gerenciamento de vulnerabilidades, um programa de risco de terceiros ou uma estratégia para endpoint, segurança de rede ou de proteção de dados

title: Machine Learning Engineering Manager
description:
Who are we?

Hi! 👋 We are Ravelin ! We're a fraud detection company using advanced machine learning and network analysis technology to solve big problems. Our goal is to make online transactions safer and help our clients feel confident serving their customers.

And we have fun in the meantime! We are a friendly bunch and pride ourselves in having a strong culture and adhering to our values of empathy, ambition, unity and integrity. We really value work/life balance and we embrace a flat hierarchy structure company-wide. Join us and you’ll learn fast about cutting-edge tech and work with some of the brightest and nicest people around - check out our Glassdoor reviews.

If this sounds like your cup of tea, we would love to hear from you! For more information check out our blog to see if you would like to help us prevent crime and protect the world's biggest online businesses.

The Team

You will be joining the Detection team, a team of machine learning engineers and data scientists. The Detection team is responsible for keeping fraud rates low by continuously training and deploying machine learning models. We aim to make model deployments as easy and error-free as code deployments. Google’s Best Practices for ML Engineering is our bible.

Our models are trained to spot multiple types of fraud, using a variety of data sources and techniques in real time. The prediction pipelines are under strict SLAs; every prediction must be returned in under 300ms. When models are not performing as expected, it’s down to the Detection team to investigate why.

The Detection team is core to Ravelin ’s success. They work in a deeply collaborative partnership with the Data Engineering team to design the data architecture and infrastructure that powers our ML systems.
The Role

We are currently looking for an Engineering Manager to line manage ML engineers and drive innovation across our suite of fraud detection products. You’ll work closely with data scientists, product, engineering and our operations teams to develop ML models and ML products. Our ideal candidate is pragmatic, approachable and filled with knowledge tempered by past failures. You will hire, coach and develop a talented machine learning team to deliver on the ML product and platform roadmap. You are in your element working with people. You’ll partner closely with senior members of Detection to discover new avenues for ML product innovation. From time to time, you’re excited to even do some software or model development yourself.

The work is not all green field research. The everyday work is about making safe incremental progress towards better models for our clients. The ideal candidate is willing to get involved in both aspects of the job - and understand why both are important.
Key Responsibilities

• Act as a key leader in establishing excellence within machine learning engineering and across the detection team

• Line manage a team of machine learning engineers - providing coaching and guidance in support of the ongoing development and growth of your team

• Propose and champion new machine learning methods and tools (including platforms that empower Data Science experimentation) to influence the technical roadmap and promote continuous innovation

• Drive cross-functional initiatives with Data Engineering, Infra, and other teams to align on data architecture and ensure we make the right ML product decisions

• Investigate model performance issues

• Develop and deploy new models to detect fraud whilst maintaining SLAs

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

• Minimum of 1 year of experience as an engineering manager, managing at least 3 people

• You are a strong collaborator with colleagues outside of your immediate team, for example with data science, engineering, product, client operations teams and with senior leadership

• You know how to manage and retain talented engineers from a diverse range of backgrounds and personalities. You can handle difficult management situations

title: Senior Associate, Regulatory Affairs
description:
For more than 25 years, Corcept has been singularly focused on the science of cortisol, a powerful hormone that when unregulated, can play a role in a broad range of diseases.

Our commercial portfolio includes treatments for hypercortisolism and oncology, and the company has discovered more than 1,000 proprietary selective cortisol modulators and glucocorticoid receptor antagonists. With advanced clinical trials in patients with hypercortisolism, solid tumors, ALS and liver disease, Corcept is unlocking the power of cortisol modulation to help address some of the most devastating diseases patients face today. 

Corcept is headquartered in Redwood City, California. To learn more, visit www.corcept.com .

• Proficient in organization, prioritization, and time management

• Experience with Microsoft Word, PowerPoint and Excel

Preferred Education and Experience:

The pay range that the Company reasonably expects to pay for this headquarters-based position is $ 125,600-$177,300 ; the pay ultimately offered may vary based on legitimate considerations, including geographic location, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and education.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us

Engelhart was founded in 2013 by BTG Pactual Group as a commodities trading company. Our business model is “asset light” and highly diversified - giving us the ability to adapt effectively and nimbly to changing market conditions. We have assembled successful multidisciplinary teams, leveraging advanced fundamental analysis with deep quantitative and weather research capabilities.  Our activities are underpinned by strong risk management practices and by powerful technology and operational excellence. We have exceptional teams with diverse global backgrounds and decades of experience, and are driven by a highly collaborative culture, across products and competencies.

In 2024, Engelhart acquired Trailstone, a global energy trading and technology company. The acquisition provides us with new expertise, analytics and proprietary technology which is being used to provide risk management and optimisation services to help maximise the value of our clients’ renewable power. The acquisition also expanded Engelhart’s capabilities into physical natural gas across North America, a critical fuel to support the energy transition.

Our talented and experienced individuals work together according to its four company values: Performance, Agility, Collaboration, Entrepreneurship .

About the Role

Engelhart is seeking a Legal Counsel with a minimum of 5 years of relevant experience to support its North American principal investment and structured origination activities, with additional responsibilities for power, natural gas, environmental products and related commodities trading matters. The role will partner closely with the principal investments and structured origination teams as well as cross-functional stakeholders throughout the lifecycle of acquisitions, joint ventures, project and structured investments, financings and other complex transactions. In addition, this individual will also provide practical legal support to the trading business and management. The ideal candidate is a hands-on, business-minded attorney who can lead transactions, exercise sound judgment and deliver commercially pragmatic advice in a fast-paced environment.

This will be a full-time role, owning the following responsibilities :

• Lead and support acquisitions, dispositions, joint ventures, strategic partnerships and other complex transactions, including transaction structuring, letters of intent, due diligence, equity and asset purchase and sale agreements, joint venture and LLC agreements, and financing and credit arrangements.

• Advise on investments and commercial arrangements involving power generation, energy storage, midstream assets, data centers, large loads, and other physical energy or infrastructure assets, including commercial, regulatory, financing, governance and risk-allocation considerations.

• Support the execution of structured origination opportunities, including long-term offtake arrangements, tolling structures, power purchase agreements, energy management arrangements, and other bespoke commercial structures.

• Draft, review and negotiate transaction-related agreements, including confidentiality agreements, exclusivity arrangements, term sheets, guarantees, security and collateral documents, intercompany arrangements, transition services agreements and other ancillary documentation.

• Provide legal support for power, natural gas, environmental products and related commodities trading activities.

• Draft, review and negotiate trading documentation, including ISDA Master Agreements and CSAs, EEI, NAESB, WSPP, long-form confirmations, netting agreements, guarantees, credit support and collateral agreements, and selected bespoke structured products or offtake arrangements.

• Coordinate transaction execution across Investments, Origination, Trading, Finance/Treasury, Tax, Credit, Risk, Compliance, Operations and Controllers, translating commercial objectives into clear legal structures and actionable workstreams.
